results.title: Lunar July
results.overview: When the gates of the spirit world open during Ghost Month, getai becomes more than just a show. Rooted in Malaysia`s Hungry Ghost Festival traditions, the film explores the taboos and unspoken rules behind the getai stage, and the price of breaking them.

results.title: Giring
results.overview: A Malaysian film that immerses audiences in a story full of challenges, conflict, and human struggle as they face life and the choices that determine the future. With direction by Marlin Brandon, the film promises a cinematic experience close to society and rich with human values and messages.

results.title: Whispers of Thunder
results.overview: Whispers of Thunder is a Bhutanese anthology capturing the quiet rumblings and malaise of youth in the capital city. A man secretly yearns to cross-dress, while a drifting young woman finds herself tangled in indecision. Two roommates go through the rhythms of city life, quietly contemplating a sense of being left behind. Another young woman slips into a fragile psychological landscape where reality and illusion begin to blur, and in the final story, a young vlogger follows a rapper who navigates the absurd frustrations of everyday life.

results.title: Gadi
results.overview: A man living in a small Konkan hamlet who is grieving the loss of his child learns that he has no free will.

results.title: XO
results.overview: They are two. They play a game, fight and compete, love and wander, yearn and mourn. They part and reunite, get bored and create, scream and dream. But can they defy the duality?

results.title: Hudke Ki Pyaang Pyaang
results.overview: In a small Himalayan town, Vikas and Jyoti, a Dalit boy and a Brahmin girl plan an escape to the city through government teaching jobs. When paying the required bribe demands selling his ailing father’s ancestral shop, Vikas hesitates, causing their relationship to crack.

results.title: The Snake Charmer
results.overview: Beyond the lush elds, the area of destruction begins. Thai labourer work in the Israeli elds on the border with Gaza. A robot snake evokes a false sense of security.

results.title: Cold River: I Am in Leipzig
results.original_title: Cold River: I Am in Leipzig
results.overview: Haiguang dreams – of his late grandmother, his hometown of Lěng Shuǐ Jiāng, his art and his job at a wholesale warehouse in Leipzig. But Haiguang doesn’t just dream. He also films.

results.title: Bully - Leider Live! Garantiert ohne Programm
results.original_title: Bully - Leider Live! Garantiert ohne Programm

results.title: Seres
results.overview: When a strange object crosses the sky and triggers a global alert, two young couples find themselves trapped in a series of increasingly disturbing events. What begins as a getaway out of town transforms into a struggle for survival as they discover they are being hunted by unknown forces.

results.title: 28 Kegs Later
results.overview: When the zombie apocalypse breaks out, two unsuspecting heroes discover that there is one trick to not get bit: You must stay drunk. They decide to throw the biggest party in town to save as many people as they can. Starring Dave Anthony (Maron) and Gareth Reynolds (New Girl), this horror-comedy is a party you won't want to miss.

results.title: Up Again
results.overview: A triple jump on ice skates lasts just a few seconds, but requires years of physical training and mental isolation. This time-lapse portrait of Barbora Vránková, three-time Czech figure skating champion, captures a pivotal period in her life between the ages of fifteen and eighteen. Her days are filled with online lessons, physiotherapy sessions and, above all, a rigorous training routine. The camera, synchronised with the protagonist’s movements, takes us straight onto the ice, where the screech of blades and the thumping of pop hits blend with the shouts of her coaches. Without any contrived pathos, the film follows how, fall after fall, the young athlete works her way towards precision on the ice and autonomy off it.

results.title: A Tree
results.overview: When urban development desecrates a sacred tree, a foreman silences the inexplicable afflictions that have taken hold of a migrant worker, only to dig up histories that refuse to be buried.

results.title: Rugosa
results.overview: A survivor lives out her days beneath the soil of a vicious wasteland. Her peace is shattered when a mysterious creature threatens her existence.

results.title: El Nieto Manuel
results.overview: A call returns Manuel to the town. His grandmother Mima, who for years wrote him letters and reflections, is no longer completely present: her memories have begun to fragment. Manuel decides to read them with her to check what remains, and in that gesture she recognizes her own need to write. For three years he records a file that documents at the same time a relationship and its transformation. While Mima's voice goes out, Manuel finds in the music a way to sustain what is leaving: not to retain it, because he understands that that is not possible, but to accompany it while it is still there.

results.title: Double Edge
results.overview: A gripping, razor-sharp independent British thriller filmed on the streets of London. Double Edge follows Alex (Ryan Hill), a man pulled deep into a high-stakes web of crime, fluid loyalties, and espionage. Forced into a deadly game of survival against the ruthless Kane Voss (Taner Hassan), Alex quickly learns that in this world, every choice is a double-edged sword.

results.title: To Be Human
results.overview: After growing weary of endless reincarnation, a man steals a UFO and journeys to the edge of the universe to uncover the meaning of life.

results.title: Çatlı 2
results.overview: Following an attack in Paris, Abdullah Çatlı is imprisoned in France, where he faces mounting danger as his family becomes a target on the outside. Caught amid political tensions and escalating pressure across Europe, he navigates a perilous struggle to protect his loved ones and find a way back home.

results.title: UZUN YAYLA
results.overview: On an ordinary day when Elbruz goes out to fish, he finds himself trapped in a deadlock after refusing, despite pressure from the people in his village, to rent out his land.

results.title: They Made Monsters
results.overview: Joaquin has been raised by his monster-hunting father to kill. But when he hears the eerily humanlike cries of a captured creature, Joaquin begins to question where the true horror lies.
